channel.title: Yorben Vandersleyen — Engineering & Apps
channel.description: Engineering logs and release announcements for native Apple ecosystem applications: Cockpit, Waybill, and modern software.

item.title: Cockpit v1.0: A Zero-Cloud macOS & iPad Productivity HUD
item.description: Announcing Cockpit v1.0.0: A modular heads-up display engineered for macOS and iPadOS consolidating Calendar, Music, Notion, and Mail into a zero-cloud physical control surface. Install via Homebrew: brew tap Yvsleyen00941/tap && brew install cockpit.

item.title: Waybill v1.0: Tactile 3D Logistics Idle Dioramas on iPadOS with RealityKit
item.description: Waybill v1.0 is now live: Explore five hand-built 3D dioramas with real-time physics dispatch, intermodal container ships, freight trains, and orbital rocket launches built with RealityKit and SwiftUI on iPad.
